subject: SOW structure: annual scan + retainer split (billing alignment)
messages:
From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@pentestpros.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: anya@redteamco.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft SOW and dual-structure pricing (annual + retainer)

Hi Soojin / Marissa,

Thanks again for taking the call last week. Attached is a first-pass SOW (PentestPros_SOW_v3.pdf) plus the ScopeMatrix.xlsx that maps each Redwood service area to our testing approach. Key points up front: we proposed an annual full-application assessment (baseline) + a separate 12-month retainer for ad-hoc red-team windows and response support.

Highlights:
- Baseline annual: code + infra + authenticated API testing, 3-week engagement window, deliverables include technical report + prioritized findings.
- Retainer: 40 hours/month (or 480 hours/year) reservable; priority scheduling, tabletop support, and two dedicated incident windows.
- Pricing: baseline $85k (one-time), retainer $120k/yr (monthly/quarterly invoice options).
- Evidence handling: we recommend SFTP transfer for logs and an ephemeral access token approach; see Section 4 of the SOW for details.

Requested next steps from your side:
1) Confirm which billable entity (Hosted API vs Dedicated) we should split costs across for internal chargebacks.
2) Confirm NDAs/PO billing contacts so we can route DocuSign and the first invoice.
3) Confirm any absolute out-of-scope items (e.g., production database snapshots).

I left comments inline in the PDF. Happy to hop on a short call to walk through.

Best,
Sam
Sam Torres
Director, Strategic Accounts | Pentest Pros
Attachments: PentestPros_SOW_v3.pdf, ScopeMatrix.xlsx, InvoiceEstimate_Q3.csv
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@pentestpros.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft SOW and dual-structure pricing (annual + retainer)

Hi Sam — thanks for the draft and the clear breakdown. A few clarifying questions before we route to Finance and Legal:

1) SOW split and chargeback: we need the invoice to be itemized so we can allocate costs between Hosted API (product) and Dedicated (enterprise). Can you give a sample invoice line-item breakdown for both the baseline and retainer? Prefer quarterly invoicing for the retainer.

2) Evidence transfer & data handling: Redaction liability needs to be explicit. We cannot accept any permanent access to customer keys or long-lived tokens. If your playbook requires credentialed testing, it must use short-lived test accounts we provide in non-prod + scoped service accounts.

3) Scope exclusions: please move production DB snapshots, real customer PII extraction, and any persistent exfiltration testing to explicit "out-of-scope" bullets.

4) Scheduling SLA: for retainer windows we need a 10-business-day lead time for non-emergency requests and a 24–48 hour SLA for incident windows; please confirm.

5) Compliance artifacts: can you include a sample SOC2 evidence checklist you commonly provide post-engagement? We will need that for audit intake.

If you can update the SOW and send a DocuSign link to Finance (finance@redwood.com), we can move to legal review. Copying Karthik to confirm procurement path.

Thanks,
Sooj
Soojin Lee
Security Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@pentestpros.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, audit@pentestpros.com
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft SOW and dual-structure pricing (annual + retainer)

Thanks Sooj — appreciate the clear list. Quick answers inline below and in the attached revised SOW (we updated Section 2, 4 and added an invoice sample):

> 1) Itemized invoice for chargebacks
We added an example line-item section: Baseline (line 1001) vs Retainer (line 2001) with per-product allocation columns. Quarterly invoicing for retainer is available; we'll set up Q-chron billing by default unless you prefer monthly.

> 2) Evidence transfer & credentialing
We will only use short-lived service accounts you provision in non-prod (we included a recommended access template). No long-lived customer keys will be requested. All evidence is transferred via SFTP-to-customer or upload to your secure share; we will never store production data beyond the report ingest window (48 hours) unless explicitly agreed.

> 3) Out-of-scope items
Added explicit bullets: production DB snapshots, exfil of live customer PII, hardware-level disruption tests (unless pre-approved).

> 4) Scheduling SLA
Confirmed: 10 business days lead time for scheduled windows; 24–48 hours for incident escalations; retainer priority scheduling guaranteed within these windows.

> 5) SOC2 artifacts
Attached a "SOC2 Evidence Checklist" (pdf) and will include the checklist with final deliverables.

We also attached InvoiceEstimate_Q3.csv to show the split and cadence. Can you confirm Finance contact and PO process so we can route DocuSign correctly?

If all good, we'll send a DocuSign packet with the revised SOW and an initial invoice for the first quarter of retainer work.

Best,
Sam
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft SOW and dual-structure pricing (annual + retainer)

Looping back after a quick review with Procurement. High-level internal asks before we sign:

- Procurement needs the vendor’s W9 and current insurance certificate; please ask Sam to attach those with the DocuSign packet.
- Finance prefers quarterly invoices for the retainer and a single PO line for the baseline assessment. We'll use cost centers: Product (Hosted API) and Enterprise (Dedicated).
- Legal asked that the redaction clause explicitly states vendor will not retain plaintext PII or credentials after delivery. Put retention window to 48 hours and require confirmation of deletion (signed checklist).

Operational items for Soojin / Security team:
- Confirm the non-prod account provisioning template (Sooj, you to own).
- Decide whether tabletop exercises are included in the first quarter of retainer hours or treated as added scopes. I recommend we include one 4-hour tabletop in Q1.

If we agree on the above, I’m happy to approve routing to Finance and ask for DocuSign.

-Marissa
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@pentestpros.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, finance@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft SOW and dual-structure pricing (annual + retainer)

Sam — thanks for the fast updates and the invoice sample. We have internal alignment on the structure pending two final items before signature:

1) Please attach vendor W9 and COI, and include the updated redaction + 48-hour evidence retention clause in DocuSign.
2) Send DocuSign to finance@redwood.com with quarterly invoice cadence selected for the retainer and PO reference DD-2027-0615-PT. Include line-item splits so we can run chargebacks.

Operational: I will own provisioning of non-prod service accounts and will send the provisioning template by EOD Monday. Tabletop: include one 4-hour tabletop in Q1 as part of the retainer.

When we receive the DocuSign packet I’ll loop in Legal for a quick review; once Legal is clear we can countersign.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this.

Sooj
Soojin Lee
Security Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: NDA_signed.pdf
